name: Loic Ard
source:
Long-term guests at the Lamplight all know the proprietress' friend, a man with gentle eyes who keeps an impressive array of potted plants in the otherwise dreary lobby. Seeing how many chores he does around the inn, newcomers tend to assume he's the owner, but it usually doesn't take long for Alma to set them straight.

[i](in-game profile, "The Not-Quite-Customer")[/i]
---
Owner of the Messenger, an unassuming flower shop favored by an eccentric clientele. Mr. Ard has garnered a reputation for his talent to convey emotion through floral arrangements with uncanny accuracy.

[i](in-game profile, "The Florist")[/i]
